needPlan.q: Do I need a plan to apply for jobs?
needPlan.a: No. Searching, saving and applying for jobs is free for everyone.

howPay.q: How do I pay for a plan?
howPay.a: Paid plans renew automatically every month through PayPal. You can cancel anytime from your profile, and access continues until the end of the period you already paid for.

cancel.a: Your subscription stays active until the current billing period ends, then it won't renew. You can subscribe again at any time.

expires.q: What happens when a subscription expires?
expires.a: You lose that plan's paid features. We notify you a few days before it expires, and again once it has.

escrow.q: Is the escrow fee included in my plan?
escrow.a: No. The 10% escrow fee applies only when a freelance milestone is released, on every plan.

limit.q: What happens when I reach my job-post limit?
limit.a: You can upgrade at any time to post more. Your existing posts stay live, and the count starts again at the next billing period.

voice.signInTitle: Sign in to use voice to text
voice.speaking: Speaking {language}. Tap stop when you're done.
voice.micAsk: Your browser will ask to use the microphone.
voice.failed: We couldn't read this recording. Try again.
voice.check: Check names and numbers. You can edit the text before copying.
voice.privacy: Recordings are turned into text on Beleqet's own servers. You can delete a transcript at any time.

resumeBrain.title: Resume Brain
resumeBrain.subtitle: Upload your CV and we’ll read it for you. Check what we found, then add it to your profile in one click.
resumeBrain.wrongType: Choose a PDF or Word file (.pdf, .doc or .docx).
resumeBrain.tooBig: That file is over {mb} MB. Choose a smaller one.
resumeBrain.readFailed: We couldn’t read that CV. Try again, or try the PDF you made it from.
resumeBrain.applyFailed: We couldn’t update your profile. Try again.
resumeBrain.deleteFailed: We couldn’t delete the file. Try again.
resumeBrain.types: PDF or Word (.docx), up to {mb} MB
resumeBrain.consent: I agree that Beleqet can read my CV to fill in my profile. The text is sent to OpenAI, our AI provider in the United States, to find my details. The file is stored with my account and I can delete it at any time.
resumeBrain.scanned: Scanned photos of a CV can’t be read yet. Use the PDF you created it from.
resumeBrain.finding: Finding your contact details, experience, education and skills. Keep this page open.
resumeBrain.reviewIntro: Here’s what we found. Fix anything that’s wrong before adding it to your profile.
resumeBrain.notFound: We couldn’t find this. Add it?
resumeBrain.noSkills: No skills found. You can add them on your profile.
resumeBrain.adds: Adds your contact details and {count} skills to your profile.
resumeBrain.doneText: We added your contact details and {count} skills.
resumeBrain.deleted: The file and what we read from it are deleted.

chat.title: Messages
chat.emptyText: Chats start when an employer messages you about an application, when you message an applicant, or when a freelance contract begins.
chat.pick: Choose a conversation to read it.
chat.connecting: Connecting… you can send once the chat is connected.
chat.startFailed: We couldn’t start that conversation. You can message employers you applied to, and their applicants.
chat.sendFailed: Your message didn’t send. Try again.

twoStep.title: Two-step sign-in
twoStep.offText: Adds a code from an authenticator app when you sign in, so a stolen password isn’t enough.
twoStep.codesLeft: {count} backup codes left. Each works once if you lose your phone.
twoStep.startFailed: We couldn’t start the setup. Try again.
twoStep.loadFailed: We couldn’t check your two-step sign-in.
twoStep.step1: Install an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
twoStep.step2: In the app, add an account and scan this code. Or type the key shown.
twoStep.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
twoStep.qrAlt: QR code to add Beleqet to your authenticator app
twoStep.codeFormat: Enter the 6 digits from your authenticator app.
twoStep.wrongCode: That code didn’t work. Check the app and try the newest code.
twoStep.disableText: Enter a code from your authenticator app to turn two-step sign-in off.
twoStep.regenerateText: Enter a code from your authenticator app. Your old backup codes will stop working.
twoStep.codesText: Keep these somewhere safe. If you lose your phone, each code signs you in once. We won’t show them again.
twoStep.fileHeading: Beleqet backup codes. Each code works once.
